title: Asked why JaCoby Jones was hitting leadoff tonight, Tigers manager Ron Gardenhir
snippet: Asked why JaCoby Jones was hitting leadoff tonight, Tigers manager Ron Gardenhire said, "You guys are writing it all the time, I might as well do it." At 61 years old, Gardenhire is always learning.
